question: Between Arc 1 and 10, are there any arcs where what you originally planned to write changed significantly from what you actually ended up writing?
answer:
Arc 2 wasn't originally planned at all, so in the sense that the entirety of Arc 2 was added, it's an expansion.

Arc 3 also became something special because while I was writing it, Wilhelm-san essentially appeared out of nowhere, and the White Whale appeared out of nowhere as well.

The fact that Meili and Elsa teamed up in Arc 4 was also something that emerged while writing it, I suppose.

Arc 5 went according to plan.

With Arc 6, there was the circumstance that during the five years when it was on hiatus, I forgot what I was originally going to write, so it probably diverged from the original plan.

And in Arc 7 and 8, we went to Vollachia, even though that wasn't something I had originally planned to do.

Arc 9 must have changed in various ways as well, so at this point, it's basically like, “What even is a plot?” (laughs)
